question: Does gradient-free, directly programmed residual composition from public observed gene-pair fitness outperform fully fitted same-information additive and bilinear controls on previously excluded historical gene pairs?
hypothesis: Local two-hop residual effect programming yields lower held pair RMSE than the strongest matched conventional control without accessing held pair outcomes before scoring.
predecessor_evidence: WSP-190 PR #1284 frozen developmental NO_GO; do not reuse its light DEV
WSP-191 isolated raw GEO source-admission branch at d63c6cdbb23f1aa793ed88860843ae7519715a39; no raw GEO data available; this is a distinct outcome and separate branch

inputs.name: Original author gene-averaged phenotype fitness matrix
inputs.transformation: Original author's GI_generate_populations.ipynb groups independent guide-level fitness phenotype matrix by gene along both axes; replicate-average source, NOT raw transcriptomic cell expression; only CSV header/identity blob seen before prereg
inputs.license: public research read-only, no copying original data into contribution repo, no license grant claimed

source_usage.data_custody: Author source and exact Git blob, not GEO publisher raw checksum
source_usage.biological_design: Historical K562 genetic-interaction growth fitness, previously published and analyzed in original author's papers, not virgin experimental condition or model-generated world
disallowed: author-precomputed processed_emap interaction predictions or scores
unseen perfect do or causal direction claims
training with author's published matrix-completion fits
source first-use owner issue #426 protected original-world actions

frozen_design.split: Canonical unordered gene pairs i<j restricted to intersection of row/column names; exclude 'negative' and any NegCtrl-prefixed row/column. If both directed measurements finite, use arithmetic mean, else use sole finite; never use diagonal. Hash SHA256('WSP192-ORIGINAL-GENE-FITNESS-v1\0'+gene_i+'\0'+gene_j); use first eight bytes big-endian modulo 100: FIT 0-69, VALID 70-84, DEV 85-99. Do not rebalance salt or pair groups after examining numeric outcomes.
frozen_design.ordering: Sort pair names ascending lexicographically before split and fitting; deterministic number arithmetic; DATA always parsed from exact Git blob, not a revised checkout.
frozen_design.data_budget: Only the complete specified ~236kB original author CSV; no other numeric source or private original-world action; require >=70 distinct genes, >=1000 observed unordered non-diagonal pairs, >=650 FIT, >=100 VALID, >=100 DEV. Failure stops gate.
frozen_design.compute_budget: One preregistered primary scoring pass after code commit; 4 additive ridge lambdas; 6 bilinear ranks/regularizations; 7 candidate beta scalars; 2 negative controls; at most 200 deterministic ALS sweeps per rank; 2000 pair bootstrap samples. No tuning after DEV.
frozen_design.capacity: Direct program: one scalar additive bias per gene, observed FIT-only pair residual entries, one scalar beta; no learned hidden architecture outside specified residual-memory footprint. Conventional bilinear: U and V each n x rank (rank 2,4,8) and same additive biases; matched FIT labels, more capacity than candidate low-order program.
frozen_design.evaluator: Normalize all target fitness values by FIT-only mean and sample-scale SD; pair-equal-weighted RMSE on VALID and separately held DEV. Strongest fully trained conventional selected by minimum VALID RMSE. Candidate beta selected on VALID. CI via 2000 pair-resampled bootstrap DEV RMSE gains, seed 19219; include full PROCESS wall time and internal target counts.

controls: FIT-only additive main-effect ridge regression (4 lambdas [0.001,0.01,0.1,1]) by convergence-stopped coordinate descent
FIT-only conventional bilinear low-rank regularized matrix completion rank [2,4,8] lambda [0.1,1] via deterministic 200-sweep ALS, VALID-ranked; same observed FIT pair values
FIT pair residual label-permutation null computed with fixed seed 19211, candidate beta chosen VALID only
candidate_algorithm: FIT-only additive biases b_i estimated by ridge coordinate descent; direct FIT residual memory R(i,k)=y(i,k)-bias(i)-bias(k) from observed FIT edges, absent edges zero and unavailable. For unobserved pair (i,j), q(i,j)=sum over shared FIT neighbors k of R(i,k)*R(j,k)/(shared_count+5), using neither VALID nor DEV pair labels or scores. Predict additive(i,j)+beta*q(i,j), beta in [-2,-1,-0.5,0,0.5,1,2] chosen min VALID RMSE. This is a non-gradient two-hop residual program; analogous classical kernel/collaborative filtering and NOT proven novel.

classification_rules.supported: At least 5% lower held DEV RMSE than strongest VALID-selected fully fitted conventional control, 2000-replicate pair-level 95% bootstrap lower gain bound >0, all original-source engineering/custody gates PASS, no source leakage and conventional optimizer convergence qualified. Remains PUBLIC_DEV not SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification_rules.mixed: Candidate improves some held metrics or costs but misses statistical/fair conventional thresholds; preserve result and no promotion.
classification_rules.negative: Candidate held RMSE ties or loses to strongest control or no validated held gain; DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO; preserve negative and no post-DEV tuning.
classification_rules.invalid: Source not exact Git blob, source shape/data-count infeasible, nonfinite input, duplicate gene labels, split leakage, code drift after first held score, optimizer/convergence or resource accounting invalid. Do not turn a scientific loss into infrastructure failure.

prohibited_after_primary_run: merge or native model integration based on public DEV
preregistration_note: Commit prereg FIRST before fetching target value rows or running any predictor; source-free coding and test allowed; train/DEV only after exact source freeze.
